name: Brightline
short_description: Virtual pediatric mental health platform offering therapy, coaching, and psychiatry for children and adolescents (ages 1.5-17), delivered through employer benefits and select health plans.
long_description: Brightline is the leading virtual behavioral health platform focused exclusively on children, adolescents, and their families. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, Brightline has raised over $200 million in funding to build a comprehensive pediatric mental health solution. The platform offers therapy, psychiatry, coaching, and digital content for children ages 1.5-17, delivered entirely via telehealth. Brightline works primarily through employer benefits partnerships with companies like Activision Blizzard, PepsiCo, and others, making services accessible to families at low or no cost. The clinical team includes licensed therapists, psychologists, and psychiatric nurse practitioners specializing in child and adolescent mental health. Brightline's approach incorporates evidence-based treatments including CBT, parent coaching, and family therapy, with a strong emphasis on measurable outcomes. For clinicians, Brightline offers W-2 employment with competitive salaries, benefits, and specialized training in pediatric telehealth. The platform provides clinicians with a steady caseload of pediatric patients, eliminating the need for marketing and administrative work. Brightline differentiates itself through its exclusive pediatric focus, family-centered approach, and integration with employer health benefits.

faqs.q: How much do Brightline therapists get paid?
faqs.a: Brightline therapists are W-2 employees with base salaries typically ranging from $70,000-100,000+ depending on license type, experience, and role. Employees receive comprehensive benefits including health insurance, 401k, paid time off, and professional development. Brightline handles all billing and administrative work.

Brightline serves children and adolescents ages 1.5 to 17 years old. The platform offers developmentally-appropriate therapy, parent coaching, and family therapy. Services are delivered via telehealth and include digital content for families to use between sessions.

faqs.q: Do I need pediatric experience to work at Brightline?
faqs.a: Experience working with children and adolescents is preferred but Brightline provides training in pediatric telehealth and evidence-based approaches. You must be fully licensed (LCSW, LMFT, LPC, PsyD, PhD, or PMHNP). Multi-state licensure is helpful given the national employer client base.

Brightline is primarily available through employer benefits. Companies partner with Brightline to offer pediatric mental health care as an employee benefit, typically at no cost or low copay for families. Access is limited to employees of partnered companies and members of select health plans.
